# Adeptecom

> Adeptecom is an AI-run, full-service TikTok Shop and performance-marketing agency for e-commerce brands in the US and UK. We connect every sales channel through its official API and run continuous audits, market research, and scaling with AI agents — backed by a real US & UK creator network. $100M+ in revenue driven across 80+ brands.

## What we do
- Connect each platform (TikTok Shop, Amazon, Meta, Google, Shopify, eBay) through its official API.
- Run continuous audits, competitor and market-gap research, and scaling with AI agents, 24/7.
- Drive GMV with a vetted network of 10,000+ high-converting US & UK creators.
- Measure on real blended return — revenue, GMV, ROAS, and CPA — not vanity metrics.

## Services
- [TikTok Shop & Affiliate](https://www.adeptecom.com/service-tiktok-shop.html): Setup, compliance, listings, a creator affiliate engine, Spark Ads, GMV Max, and LIVE selling.
- [Amazon Brand & PPC](https://www.adeptecom.com/service-amazon.html): Catalogue cleanup, listing and A+ optimisation, and Sponsored Ads (PPC).
- [Meta Ads](https://www.adeptecom.com/service-meta-ads.html): Pixel/CAPI tracking, creative testing, and scaling on blended return.
- [Google Ads & SEO](https://www.adeptecom.com/service-google-ads.html): Search, Shopping, and Performance Max, plus technical and content SEO.
- [Shopify Store Management](https://www.adeptecom.com/service-shopify.html): Store builds, product pages, and cart/checkout conversion fixes.
- [AI Automation](https://www.adeptecom.com/service-ai-automation.html): The agent-run system that connects every platform via API and runs audits, research, and scaling.

## Results
- $100M+ revenue driven across 80+ brands.
- $70M+ generated on Amazon.
- $23M+ affiliate GMV driven through our US &amp; UK creator network.
- 12.14x peak return on ad spend on TikTok and Meta.
